Lemma
[Uniform Lipschitz bound for broken geodesics] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0472, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0473 1. apph:H.55\group Integral curves Every broken geodesic $\Gamma (x,P)$ built from nearest superlevel points satisfies \[ d_C(\Gamma (x,P)(s),\Gamma (x,P)(s'))\le C|s-s'|, \] where $C$ depends only on $\operatorname {diam}(C)$, $f_{\sup }$, and the terminal level below $f_{\sup }$, not on the partition $P$.
